name: Beads
source: beads_quickstart.pdf p5, p8 and p12 (panel close-ups, jacks 1-8)
notes: ASSIGN CV is the assignable CV input (7), marked only with the feedback/dry-wet/reverb icons; it routes to feedback, dry/wet or reverb amount selected by button [M]. TIME/SIZE/SHAPE/PITCH CV jacks are unlabelled (dotted lines to attenurandomizers). PITCH CV tracks 1V/oct. IN L normalled to IN R (mono when only L patched). OUT R unpatched sums both channels to OUT L. Not in VCV port list (no cross-check).
